info.name: CampusCompass
info.description: Example requests and saved example responses for the CampusCompass API. Import into Postman, set the `baseUrl` variable if needed, and ensure the server and MySQL are running with `sql/schema.sql` applied.

request.description: Creates a school. Body: name, address, latitude, longitude (required). Returns 201 with the created row including `id`, or 400 with validation details.

response.name: Example — 400 Validation failed

request.description: Lists all schools with Haversine distance (km) from the given point, nearest first. Query: latitude, longitude (required). Returns 200 with `schools` array, or 400 if coordinates are missing or invalid.

response.name: Example — 200 OK (sorted)
Example — 400 Validation failed
